The unmodified `elsarticle` 3.5 (2026-01-09) class sources, README, manifest, and
numbered bibliography style are from the Elsevier-maintained CTAN distribution:
https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/elsarticle.zip

Downloaded 20 September 2026. `elsarticle.cls` in the project root was generated
from `elsarticle.ins` and `elsarticle.dtx` using the standard docstrip utility:

```
tectonic --outfmt xdv --pass tex --keep-intermediates elsarticle.ins
```

The corresponding `elsarticle-num.bst` is also in the project root. Copyright
and LaTeX Project Public License notices remain in these official files. The
vendor source files here allow regeneration of the class; this subset is not
the complete CTAN documentation bundle described by its upstream manifest.
